content: {"episode_id":"ep-05032","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presented with recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9). Mobile cardiac telemetry, billed as CPT 93229, was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion. The submitted clinical indication note documents this medical necessity, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial; the service falls within 47 days of the date of service and this appeal is submitted within the filing deadline."}
